note: RR-370 (4 Nov 2026). Each entry was read on its own page on the date given. text: wrong or incomplete words and the checked words. cite: a claim holding these words is cited to the document that says them. links: an address and the right one. RR-385 (7 Nov 2026): the Ahpra board lines, as Ahpra's own page says them. RR-386 (7 Nov 2026): the Alabama Board of Nursing line, as its own page says it.

gradeB.text: OET's own guide: grade A is 450 to 500, grade B is 350 to 440, grade C+ is 300 to 340, grade C is 200 to 290; grades D and E are below 200.

text.has: Grade B corresponds to a scale score of 350
text.to: OET reports each sub-test as a grade from A to E. OET's own guide: grade A is 450 to 500, grade B is 350 to 440, grade C+ is 300 to 340, grade C is 200 to 290; grades D and E are below 200. The grade you need is set by the organisation asking for the result.
text.why: grade B is a band, not one score

text.has: In Australia: Medical Board of Australia (via Ahpra). Accepts OET.
text.to: In Australia, all National Boards under Ahpra except the Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Health Practice Board accept the same English tests and minimum scores, the Medical Board of Australia among them; OET is accepted, and for tests taken on or after 23 April 2026 it asks Listening 350, Reading 360, Writing 350 and Speaking 360, with no overall score.
text.why: RR-385: the line said the board itself set the rule and cited a policy PDF that names no board, so the truth pass failed it on most pages; Ahpra's page says all National Boards except one share the same tests and scores, names each board, and holds Table 2

text.has: Alabama Board of Nursing names OET on its own page among the English tests it accepts; the page does not say which score
text.to: In the United States — Alabama (state board): the Alabama Board of Nursing names OET on its own page among the English tests it accepts from graduates of foreign nursing programs, with these scores: Reading 340, Listening 320, Writing 350 and Speaking 360.
text.source: Alabama Board of Nursing — its own page
text.why: RR-386: the line said the page gives no score per sub-test; the Board's own page lists OET Reading 340, Listening 320, Writing 350, Speaking 360, so the truth pass failed it
